heroHeadline: Chernobyl Exclusion Zone Struck Again: Drone Hits Spent Fuel Store, Fire Tornado Blankets Kyiv in Smog
heroSubtitle: A Russian Shahed drone damaged the ISF-2 spent nuclear fuel storage facility on June 7, drawing an IAEA warning against 'attacking a facility with large amounts of nuclear material.' Weeks later, drone-sparked wildfires and a rare fire tornado swept the exclusion zone from June 25 to July 14, blanketing Kyiv in smog; radiation stayed within normal limits throughout both incidents, and New Safe Confinement repair funding has reached €70M of an estimated €100M+ needed.
footerNote: Data sourced from IAEA, UNSCEAR, WHO, Ukrainian government archives, Soviet/Russian state archives, Chernobyl Forum (2005), TORCH Report (2006), and peer-reviewed research.
